purpose: Prevent workflow, test, or evidence completeness from being mistaken for professional capability completeness.

qualityLayers.Q2: Evidence, provenance, calculation, policy, authority and compliance correctness
qualityLayers.Q3: Independent professional-excellence review by the disciplines materially required by the deliverable

rules: Q1 or Q2 PASS never substitutes for Q3.
Every material RUN requires a Professional Capability Manifest before consequential execution.
Every material or gating discipline must map to an explicitly registered specialist capability.
A generic agent does not inherit a profession merely because it can reason about the subject.
Multiple professions may be covered by one component only when each discipline is separately qualified.
A material author cannot serve as the independent Q3 reviewer for the same discipline.
A missing or unproven gating discipline sets professionalReadiness=BLOCKED.
A provisional gating specialist sets professionalReadiness=BLOCKED until calibrated.
A missing material non-gating discipline may be CONDITIONAL only with an explicit owner-accepted limitation.
Overall READY requires Operational READY, Evidence READY, and Professional READY with PE_PASS or an allowed conditional PE_PASS_WITH_LIMITATION.
Execution-only workflows with no material professional judgment may declare Q3_NOT_APPLICABLE, but the exemption must be explicit and scoped to the deterministic action only.
overallRule: overallReadiness is READY only when all required dimensions are READY; otherwise BLOCKED.
auditClosureRule: The specialist-gap audit is closed when every active/material team is mapped, missing capability is blocked or explicitly accepted as a visible limitation, generic role conflation is removed or registered separately, Q1/Q2/Q3 are distinct, and core completion enforcement prevents false READY claims. Individual blocked teams may remain blocked after audit closure; they must pass calibration before professional promotion.
